exp13_scope: Hand-designed SEANet encoder same-condition control vs exp2 NAS encoder. Same distill30 + same data + same loss + same optimizer; only encoder architecture differs (n_filters=64, strides=[8,5,4,2], lstm_layers=2 — original SEANet) vs exp2's NAS seed42-000896 (n_filters=24, strides=[5,4,4,4], lstm_layers=1, layer_ops=[skip,std_k7,sep_k9,dil_k5]).
exp13_epoch_budget_note: 30 epoch (half of exp2's 60-epoch schedule) — exp2 dev/mel reached its plateau around step 107500 (~32 epoch); 30 epoch is sufficient to answer 'is hand-designed encoder better/equal/worse than NAS at the same step budget'.
exp13_no_nas_encoder_config_note: nas_encoder_config field intentionally OMITTED so train_example.py instantiates plain SpeechTokenizer with the n_filters/strides above (full SEANet).
